name: radio transcript
content_styles: Write like a late-night radio show transcript about the topic. A host, callers, sound effects in brackets, and a sign-off. Voice is warm, rambling, and increasingly unhinged.
Write like a public radio interview transcript. A host, a 'guest' (the topic), questions, answers, and a pledge-drive interruption. Voice is earnest and slightly awkward.
Write like a pirate radio broadcast. A DJ, a playlist, callers, static interruptions, and a 'stay tuned' sign-off. Voice is chaotic and enthusiastic.
layouts: Build a radio transcript: a station header, a host intro, caller segments with names, sound effect notes, and a sign-off. One continuous broadcast log.
Build an interview transcript: a station header, a host intro, Q&A segments, a pledge-drive interruption, and a sign-off. One continuous transcript.
Build a pirate radio log: a station header, a DJ intro, playlist entries, caller segments, static notes, and a sign-off. One continuous broadcast.
themes: Radio look: dark background, warm amber accents, a microphone feel, and a clean sans-serif. Unified and late-night.
Public radio look: white background, blue accents, a formal sans-serif, and a clean feel. Unified and earnest.
Pirate radio look: dark background, neon accents, a chaotic feel, and a bold sans-serif. Unified and rebellious.

elements.name: station_id
elements.content: STATION: [a station call sign and frequency]
